scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I recently submitted an application for a VA cash-out refinance loan. Could you please tell me the current status or outcome of my application?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your inquiry. Your VA cash-out refinance loan application has been approved and the loan has been originated. If you have questions about your loan details or next steps, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know my application was approved! Could you tell me what my interest rate is, and what the total costs of this loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 6.5%. The total costs associated with your loan amount to $16,458.83. If you need clarification on any of these amounts or have other questions, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the details. Could you let me know if my loan is classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage or if there are any negative amortization features on the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. If you have additional questions about these or other aspects of your loan, feel free to ask.

dialogue.user: That’s great to hear, thank you! One more question: Has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution, or is it still with your bank?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has been sold to Ginnie Mae after origination. If you have any further questions about what this means or need more details, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for clarifying that. I feel like you've answered all my questions clearly and directly. I appreciate the straightforward information about the approval, loan terms, and purchaser, and you explained everything in an easy-to-understand way.

<Satisfied> 

I’m satisfied because you gave me all the details I needed in a professional and clear manner.
